comment: Still no lossless in Premium and now they want more money for the same thing. Tidal and Deezer already include hi-fi and Apple Music does too. If they're raising the price they should at least add lossless. I'm pretty much on Tidal full time at this point.

So they want MORE money for a home screen that is TikTok inspired junk. Bring back the old UI or I'm done. Recently played and my playlists are gone and I'm not paying for scrolling cards. Apple Music is looking real good right now.

Another price hike for an app that gets worse with every redesign. Recommendations are stale, shuffle and autoplay are a mess, and the home page is still confusing. I stay for the playlists and podcasts but YouTube Music is looking better every month.

Cool, pay more for a playlist app that still can't show me my liked songs inside a playlist and can't add duplicates on mobile. Enhance keeps shoving recommended tracks into my stuff. I already left Premium over this crap, so the price doesn't change anything for me, but it's still annoying.

A dollar more for no ads, offline downloads and casting is still a no-brainer. The free tier is basically unusable so I'm not going anywhere. My actual complaint is the promoted stuff and pop-ups that show up even for Premium users, but the price itself is fine.

A dollar more is nothing for the whole catalog. Still an incredible deal, honestly it should cost more if it means artists get paid better. Tidal's payout plan is not really in place yet so there's no real alternative for the artists side. Pay the artists, that's the moral case.

Ugh. Another dollar on top when I already can't pay consistently some months. Probably dropping back to the free experience for a while. And of course I'll get the renew emails after cancelling, great.

Apple Music is a way better deal. Lossless and Spatial Audio are included in the same plan, and Spotify is cheap in my country but the sound quality is still lossy. I like Spotify Connect and Chromecast but I prefer Apple Music now and this hike makes the choice easier.

Pay more for the same app that keeps changing under me? I already have auto updates off and an old version installed so I don't have to deal with the new layout. If they force the new layout permanently I'm out, and I already cancelled once after an update I didn't want.

Price going up while they keep taking features away with no explanation. Half the time the features roll out to some users only and then disappear again. I would pay a one-time price for an app that does what this one used to do, so the monthly hike is a hard sell.

Paying more and I still get ads in my podcasts. Premium is supposed to be ad-free but that clearly isn't the case for podcasts, and they keep pushing shows on me. If they keep this up I'm looking at YouTube Premium. Just want music.

I already cancelled my family plan over the podcast-stuffed home screen. A price hike doesn't change anything for me. The home page is still full of shows I never play and I can't permanently hide them. Show me the music.

Eh, I'm on free and fine with ads as long as I can hear what I like. Premium is still worth it if you want to pick songs and skip without ads, but $11 is a bit much when the free tier mostly does the job for me. I'll probably end up paying again eventually.

Honestly a dollar more is fine, the library is still the best and I keep coming back after trying others. My gripe is the recs that keep suggesting songs I already have and personalized playlists repeating the same picks. Hopefully some of the money goes into better recommendations.
Family plan going up a dollar is nothing when you split it between the household. A few bucks each a month and every person still gets their own account and no ads. Still worth every penny for us.

Not paying anything since I cancelled, but the renew subscription pop-up still shows up every time I open the app. Clearing cache and reinstalling did nothing. Anyone else getting this after the last update? It's annoying as hell.

Absolutely hate this update. The music tab is a feed of cards now and autoplay keeps playing songs I didn't pick. I cancelled premium over this layout, and I'm switching to Apple Music if the new music tab stays. Price hike is just salt in the wound. No way to contact support either.

Basic stuff like the heart button should not be behind a paywall and now they want more money. Liked songs are mixed into playlist updates, I can't see liked tracks inside playlists, and video clips autoplay while I browse. I'm switching back to Apple Music if this doesn't get fixed, I might unsubscribe.

Per-stream royalties are already fractions of a cent and now they charge more for the same thing. Spotify does not pay artists more than the others, and the scarcity game with label deals is not helping musicians. I'm staying out of habit but this doesn't sit right with me.

Premium is still a good bang for the buck for the huge catalog and the lifestyle features. Around $11 a month just to kill ads is a bit much for me though, and I keep an eye on how the free tier is getting more ads. I'm fine paying it for now and can leave whenever quality drops.

Shuffle is still not random and it plays the same songs from my big playlists again and again. Now it takes two taps to reach regular shuffle. I pay for Spotify mostly for the UI and Connect but if shuffle doesn't get fixed I'm seriously looking at Apple Music, and the price bump makes it worse.

Price doesn't bother me much. I'm here for the algorithm and the catalog, and no other service matches the features yet. Spotify hides play counts and the radio keeps filling with songs I already know, which is the real issue, but I'm not leaving over a dollar.

Spotify still has no lossless tier and now they're charging more. Tidal and Qobuz already offer hi-fi for similar or less money, and artists get paid better there. I'll keep Spotify for Connect and discovery but the sound is still the reason I'm on Tidal. Spotify HiFi would be worth paying extra for, just give it to us.

Oh no, the student price going up. It was already a great deal with Hulu and Showtime included, but I'm on a tight student budget. If the student plan goes up I'm honestly going back to Apple Music, which is what I said I'd do. Anyone else get charged twice for the student discount?

Another price increase and the app still breaks after every update. Reinstalling is the only thing that fixes playback half the time, and my downloads still won't play offline. Turn off auto update and wait for a fix. Customer service is slow or nonexistent.

Not paying more for an app that still can't show me my liked songs on albums and artist pages. I already unsubscribed once, and if they keep taking features away I will unsubscribe again. Daily mix is nice but it's not worth the money with this track list.
